Look for anything that would stop the lock on 2026-10-29 or the score on 2026-10-30: the Mac and the runner pushing at once, merge conflicts in live files, uncommitted files blocking the daily job, the runner's environment (no .venv, no ~/.gdn_disclosure, no raw SEC files), time zones, and the 19:00 ET rule.
